description: Solo builder, designing new ways to use and look at datasets from nasa and affiliated partner.
summary: Cronoscope is an interactive astronomy platform that makes NASA SPHEREx observations accessible to the public. It enables users to explore astronomical imagery across wavelengths, examine celestial coordinates, and compare observations over time through blinking and difference visualizations. Built using authentic scientific data, Cronoscope combines accessible visualization with reproducible analysis tools to support exploration and moving-object research.
details: Most astronomy viewers show us what the universe looks like. Cronoscope explores how it changes. By connecting observations across time and wavelengths, it turns archived telescope data into an investigative experience. Rather than simply displaying beautiful images, Cronoscope helps users examine evidence, investigate potential movement, and understand the difference between scientific observations and discoveries.
